Name: Venue Contract Signing and AV Recording Confirmation
Description: I want it signed before they change their minds. Diego, get the contract through legal review and signed by end of next week, and confirm the AV package includes recording in all three rooms, last year we lost the breakout talks because recording was main-hall only.

Name: Speaker Lineup Lock
Description: Two maybes, one decline. My plan: I'll send final follow-ups to the two maybes with a decision deadline of Friday, and I have a backup list of five names if either falls through. Worst case I fill the third slot from the backup list. Either way I'll have the lineup locked in two weeks so we can print the agenda.

Name: Keynote Abstract Chase
Description: I'll chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week, we need it for the website and the printed program.

Name: Email Campaign Three Waves
Description: Historically the surge comes after the agenda goes live, but we shouldn't just wait. I'll run the email campaign in three waves: agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, and a final-week push. I'll draft all three this month, and the first wave goes out the day the agenda is live.

Name: Speaker Pages Handoff for Website
Description: Bo, once the lineup locks, hand the bios and headshots straight to Diego for the landing page update, same day, don't sit on them.

Name: Swag Order Approval and Placement
Description: Order's ready to place: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, comes to about 9,200 with the rush buffer. I just need your sign-off on the design proofs, they're in the shared drive. I'll review the proofs today, and once I approve, you place the order this week, lead time was six weeks last year, we're already cutting it close.

Name: Next Check-in
Description: Next check-in same time in two weeks, with the lineup locked and the contract signed, please.
